usage: Use 向日葵 as a common countable noun for the flower sunflower. It sounds natural in everyday speech and written Chinese.
It can stand alone or take a classifier when you count flowers, especially 一朵向日葵 or 一棵向日葵 depending on what you are referring to.
This word is mainly used in plant names, gardening talk, gift-giving, and simple descriptions of color or appearance.
For learners, 向日葵 is a neutral, everyday word; it is not slang, and it works well in both casual conversation and school-style writing.
